items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to the characteristics of addiction, ICD-10 dependence syndrome criteria, biological and learning theory explanations, and drug therapy vs counselling.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: BBC Radio 4's mental health series includes episodes on addiction science, recovery, and the debate between biological and psychological models of dependence.

items.title: Everything you think you know about addiction is wrong — Johann Hari (TED)
items.description: Widely discussed TED talk arguing that social connection — not just chemistry — drives addiction and recovery. Good for evaluating the biological theory and exploring alternative perspectives.

items.title: Psychological Disorders: Crash Course Psychology #28
items.description: Crash Course overview of how disorders including substance-related conditions are classified — provides useful background on how addiction fits within the broader framework of psychological problems.

items.title: Beautiful Boy (2018)
items.description: Based on true memoirs by father and son, this film follows a family through the cycle of meth addiction and recovery — a measured, educational portrayal of dependence that avoids glorification. Certificate 15.

items.title: OCD and Anxiety Disorders: Crash Course Psychology #29
items.description: Crash Course episode on compulsive and anxiety-based disorders — useful context for understanding how addiction shares features with OCD, including compulsive behaviour and loss of control.

items.title: Mind — Mental health information hub
items.description: Mind charity's main hub — use the A-Z guide to find plain-English explanations of addiction, dependence, and related mental health conditions.

items.title: YoungMinds — Mental health conditions
items.description: UK charity site with accessible guides to mental health and addiction written specifically for young people — bridges the gap between textbook theory and lived experience.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology specification
items.description: Official AQA spec — check exactly which theories and therapies for addiction appear on the exam, and how much detail is required.
